headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 24, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals' Jordan Walker continues to make headlines, leading the team's offense in two separate games against the Cincinnati Reds. Walker hit a home run and had three RBIs in an 8-1 Cardinals victory, but the Reds rallied back to win 7-6 in a thrilling finish.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Washington Nationals right-hander Jake Irvin, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain. Other notable injuries include Chicago Cubs pitcher Edward Cabrera, who has been out since May 21 with a right middle-finger blister, and Tampa Bay Rays outfielder Jonny DeLuca, who has been on the 10-day injured list since May 23 with a right hamstring strain.

Several teams have made roster moves, including the Cincinnati Reds, who traded right fielder Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for right-hander Zach McCambley. The Philadelphia Phillies also traded right-hander Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Reds 8-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-1 victory. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past Cardinals in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 7-6, securing a crucial win. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Reds' strong showing.

top_news.title: **Astros Shut Out Cubs 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a dominant 3-0 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Walker leading the offense and Kai-Wei Teng pitching a strong 6.0 innings.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2, with Patrick Corbin earning the win after 6.0 innings of work, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Reds Shut Down Cardinals in Thrilling 0-0 Affair**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a hard-fought 0-0 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with no standout hitters or pitchers emerging in the game. Ke'Bryan Hayes and Zach McCambley played key roles for the Reds in the win.

top_news.title: **Nationals' Jake Irvin Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals right-hander Jake Irvin has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move Ahead of Sunday's Game**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies have traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money.
